The center panel shows a blank white page labeled “Product Code:” at the top. The right panel, titled “Pages”, displays two thumbnail previews of label templates — page 1 is unselected, while page 2 is selected and enclosed in a red box with a blue border; next to it are icons for rotate, flip, and delete.
